title: The Homecoming of Maple Street
author: Odile Sandoval
blurb: Bram Yarrow, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
